title: incidents
text:
incidents

incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-2543 — inference-eu-high-error-rate. Priority P1. Trigger: 500 errors > threshold. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2543

pagerbot: PD-2543 routed to oncall-eu, escalation in 5m if unacked. Auto-assignment pending.

miguel: acked — taking it now :hand:

sarah: ack — thanks. do we know customer impact yet? any customer traffic failing or degradations?

miguel: quick snapshot: hosted API eu-west-1 showing 500 spikes from model-serving pool, error rate ~18% over last 3m, p50 latency ~2x. Affects text-generation endpoints; embeddings look fine.

pagerbot: PD-2543 assigned to miguel (oncall).

jon: if it's model-serving pool, can we failover traffic to us-west or switch to a lighter model variant? miguel, can you confirm if there was a deploy around 08:50?

miguel: checking deploys... last deploy to dedicated-pool (model-serving-eu) at 08:50 UTC. starting rollback to previous revision now. running: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-serving-eu --to-revision=3```

miguel: rollback initiated, rolling pods. will post status when done.

linda: support pinged — I've opened a high-priority internal ticket and told frontline to hold EU trial signups. ready to update customers if we need a status page incident.

miguel: rollback finished, pods restarted. current error rate down to ~1.2%, latency trending to baseline. continuing to monitor for 30m.

incidentbot: PD-2543 update — acked by miguel; mitigation applied (rollback). Monitoring window open for 30m.

sarah: great. miguel — when you have a sec please add a short timeline + suspected cause (deploy-related?) to the incident doc and link PR. we'll close after observation window if stable :thumbsup:

miguel: will do — saving logs and pod diffs now, linking PR in incident doc in ~15m. leaving thread open for handoff/notes.
